Aap keh deejiye ke aye kaafiro
Main un khudaaon ki ibaadat nahin kar sakta jin ki tum pooja karte ho
Aur na tum mere Khuda ki ibaadat karne waale ho
Aur na main tumhaare maaboodon ki pooja karne waala hoon
Aur na tum mere Maabood ke ibaadat-guzaar ho
Tumhaare liye tumhaara deen hai aur mere liye mera deen hai
